voltage_levels.voltage_note: Existing 400/130 kV station expanded with a new 400/130 kV transformer and a new 130 kV switchgear.

scope_description: Expansion of Grönviken with a new 400/130 kV transformer and new 130 kV switchgear. Bundled with a new double line from Grönviken to Ockelbo. A signed customer connection agreement at Grönviken triggers immediate start.

timeline.timeline_note: Two-phase commissioning visible on the Gantt: 2028 and 2029.

contract.contract_note: Gantt label '<200 MSEK' (separate package). Bundled with a separate ground-work procurement for the same site.

dependencies.customer_agreement: Signed customer connection agreement at Grönviken — implies immediate project start.

raw_status: Anslutningsavtal med kund — innebär omgående start
narrative_note: Grönviken is a 400/130 kV node that today injects only wind into the transmission grid. The new transformer + 130 kV switchgear plus the new double line to Ockelbo enable load supply once the Ockelbo 220 kV is decommissioned.
